values.note: City of Sheldon: RV camping $20 a night, tents $10. Self-pay envelope at the kiosk, cash or check.

fees.source: https://sheldoniowa.gov/pages/parks-rec-pool ('RV Camping is $20 per night, and tent camping is $10 per night'; page footer 2026), read 2026-11-02

hookups.source: https://sheldoniowa.gov/pages/parks-rec-pool ('26 campsites, equipped with electrical and water hookups at each site. All electrical sites have 40 AMP-220 VOLT, 30 AMP-110 VOLT, and 20 AMP-110 VOLT'; 40 amp snapped down to 30), read 2026-11-02

booking.source: https://sheldoniowa.gov/pages/parks-rec-pool ('Hills Park Campsites are a first come, first basis. No reservations are taken.'), read 2026-11-02

note: City of Sheldon park on the north end of town, west off 2nd Avenue: trees, hills and open green space, playground, picnic shelters, 9-hole disc golf, recreational-trail trailhead. --Claude
summary: All confirmed from the city page: $20, 26 sites, electric + water, 40A snapped to 30, dump, first-come. Not waterfront stands. Page silent on rig length and season.
